# freehire

> freehire is a free, open-source job-search service. It collects public IT and
> non-IT vacancies from company career pages and other sources, normalizes and
> deduplicates them, and makes the catalogue searchable.

## Public job search

The site and its public JSON API do not require an account or API key. Use the
API reference or OpenAPI contract to discover the supported endpoints and
response shapes.

- [API reference](https://freehire.me/docs/api)
- [OpenAPI contract](https://freehire.me/openapi.yaml)
- API base URL: `https://freehire.me/api/v1`

Search results support keyword queries, filters, and sorting. Vacancy pages
link to the original source for applications; freehire does not accept or track
applications.

## Explore

- [Jobs](https://freehire.me/jobs): search and filter the job catalogue.
- [Companies](https://freehire.me/companies): browse companies with open roles.
- [Collections](https://freehire.me/collections): explore curated groups of roles.
- [Market insights](https://freehire.me/insights): catalogue-wide role, skill,
  salary, and company summaries.
- [About](https://freehire.me/about): how the project works.
- [Privacy policy](https://freehire.me/privacy): data processed by the service.
